content.json:
# AVD Insights ダッシュボード
Azure Virtual Desktop の監視・分析用ダッシュボードです。

content.query:
WVDConnections
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize TotalConnections = count(), SuccessfulConnections = countif(State == 'Connected'), FailedConnections = countif(State == 'Failed')
| extend SuccessRate = round(todouble(SuccessfulConnections) / todouble(TotalConnections) * 100, 2)
content.title: 接続サマリー

content.query:
WVDConnections
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), State
| render timechart
content.title: 接続トレンド (時間別)

content.query:
WVDConnections
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where State == 'Failed'
| summarize FailureCount = count() by CorrelationId, UserName, SessionHostName
| sort by FailureCount desc
| take 20
content.title: 接続失敗一覧 (Top 20)

content.query:
WVDAgentHealthStatus
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SessionHostName
| summarize Available = countif(Status == 'Available'), Unavailable = countif(Status == 'Unavailable'), NeedsAssistance = countif(Status == 'NeedsAssistance'), Shutdown = countif(Status == 'Shutdown')
content.title: Session Host ステータス

content.query:
WVDAgentHealthStatus
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SessionHostName
| project SessionHostName, Status, LastHeartBeat, ActiveSessions, AllowNewSessions, AgentVersion, OSVersion
| sort by Status asc
content.title: Session Host 一覧

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'User Input Delay per Session' and CounterName == 'Max Input Delay'
| summarize AvgDelay = avg(CounterValue), MaxDelay = max(CounterValue), P95Delay = percentile(CounterValue, 95) by Computer
| sort by AvgDelay desc
content.title: ユーザー入力遅延 (ms) - Session Host 別

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'User Input Delay per Session' and CounterName == 'Max Input Delay'
| summarize AvgDelay = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer
| render timechart
content.title: ユーザー入力遅延トレンド

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Processor Information' and CounterName == '% Processor Time' and InstanceName == '_Total'
| summarize AvgCPU = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer
| render timechart
content.title: CPU 使用率トレンド

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Memory' and CounterName == 'Available Mbytes'
| summarize AvgMem = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer
| render timechart
content.title: メモリ空き容量トレンド (MB)

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'RemoteFX Network' and CounterName == 'Current TCP RTT'
| summarize AvgRTT = avg(CounterValue), P95RTT = percentile(CounterValue, 95) by Computer
| sort by AvgRTT desc
content.title: ネットワーク RTT (ms)

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'FSLogix Apps' and CounterName == 'Profile Load Time (ms)'
| summarize AvgLoadTime = avg(CounterValue), MaxLoadTime = max(CounterValue), P95LoadTime = percentile(CounterValue, 95) by Computer
| sort by AvgLoadTime desc
content.title: FSLogix プロファイルロード時間 (ms)

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Source == 'Microsoft-FSLogix-Apps'
| where EventLevelName in ('Error', 'Warning')
| summarize Count = count() by EventLevelName, EventID, RenderedDescription
| sort by Count desc
| take 20
content.title: FSLogix エラー・警告 (Top 20)

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Terminal Services'
| where CounterName in ('Active Sessions', 'Inactive Sessions', 'Total Sessions')
| summarize Value = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), CounterName
| render timechart
content.title: セッション数トレンド

content.query:
WVDConnections
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where State == 'Connected'
| summarize SessionDuration = avg(datetime_diff('minute', EndTime, StartTime)) by UserName
| sort by SessionDuration desc
| take 20
content.title: ユーザー別平均セッション時間 (分)
